mandrake.final: a mandrake root with a leafy top, root shaped like a small person

stage_notes.sprout: add two small clearly visible dark eyes with tiny white glints on the root just below the leaves; red pupils in the black eyes; orbs 3x3
stage_notes.growing: make the top of the root just below the leaves wide and bulbous like a turnip, keep the roots below; two 3x3 black eyes with red centres on the bulb; taper the bulbous root top smoothly downward into the sprawling roots, and add a few faint horizontal ring lines across the bulb like a turnip or daikon, keep the eyes

stage_notes.growing: bulb shifted to off-white with a light yellow tint; leaves original green

stage_notes.growing: bulb shifted from orange to yellow

stage_prompts.growing: drooping grey-green leaves with one closed pale grey bud hanging down, two faint dark eye marks on the bud

stage_notes.sprout: reshape the two blue leaves into round sleigh-bell shapes with a small cross-hatch slit line on each, same blue colour
stage_notes.growing: replace the bud with two larger round blue bell-shaped buds hanging down from short stems, side by side, clearly bells
